name: petest
title: PE test of y on x against log(y) on sqrt(x). Rows with a non-finite auxiliary value are omitted.

origin.description: PE test of y on x against log(y) on sqrt(x). Rows with a non-finite auxiliary value are omitted.
origin.details: Both PE rows: estimate, standard error, t, and p-value.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.

translation.description: PE test of y on x against log(y) on sqrt(x). Rows with a non-finite auxiliary value are omitted.
translation.details: Both PE rows: estimate, standard error, t, and p-value.
translation.value: The same value R returns for this call.
translation.example:
from lmtest import petest
import numpy as np
x = np.array([1,3,2,6,5,8,7,4,9,10,12,11,15,13,14,18,16,19,17,20], float)
y = np.array([2,2,4,3,7,6,9,8,5,11,10,14,12,16,15,13,19,17,20,18], float)
z = np.sqrt(x)
print(petest(y, x, np.log(y), z))
